in_sanskrit.name: अमरजित
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Amarjit is derived from two Sanskrit words: ‘अमर’ (amr) meaning immortal and ‘जित’ (jit) meaning victory. Thus, Amarjit can be translated to Immortal Victor or Deathless Victor.

in_hindi.name: अमरजित
in_hindi.long_meaning: अमर (amr) in Hindi means immortal, and जित (jit) means victory. Therefore, Amarjit translates to Immortal Victor or Deathless Victor in Hindi as well.

in_marathi.name: Amarjit
in_marathi.long_meaning: Amarjit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Amarjit is a Sanskrit name derived from 'Amar', meaning 'immortal'. The suffix 'jit' denotes 'victory' or 'conqueror'. In Hindu mythology, Amarjit is believed to represent the divine power of immortality and invincibility.
